composition_variation: Depict an original 33-year-old anime woman with dark skin and long black braids, standing confidently beside a calm desert dune. She wears an opaque rust-colored field coat, high-neck sand shirt, full trousers, sturdy boots, and a light scarf secured at the neck. Use textured gouache, terracotta and powder-blue contrasts, soft sunrise shadows, and wind-shaped fabric. One hand gently grips her backpack strap as she looks toward the horizon. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
